Alex (Runtime): heads up — hitting a p99 tail spike on text-gen after the 23:00 deploy. p95 fine, p99 ~1.2s (baseline ~420ms).
Mira (Perf): seeing the spike too. heatmap shows traffic concentrated on ~6 shards, queue depth on those hosts shot up.
Jordan (Oncall): alert page with graphs: https://grafana/redwood/prod/tx-gen — looks like queueing rather than compute.
Alex (Runtime): parked a quick flame output from one affected host:
```
waiting_in_queue_ms: 820
service_time_ms: 190
kernel_time_ms: 120
```
Raj (Infra): deploy bot shows the deploy changed the batching policy and kernel selector at the same time: configblame: `batcher.v2.enabled=true` and `microbatch_max_size: 32` (was 8).
Helena (ML): model sequences are mostly short (avg 24 tokens), bumping microbatch max to 32 will pack many tiny requests into a long pipeline, could be head-of-line blocking.
Mira (Perf): profiled the runtime — 65% of extra latency is `queue_wait` in the scheduler. Kernel selection also skewed: small-seq path now picks a slower quantized kernel when batch size >16.
Alex (Runtime): minimal repro on canary: with `max_queue_time_ms=100` p99 increases, but reducing to 20ms returns to baseline. The rollout increased `max_queue_time_ms` from 20 -> 100 to improve throughput.
Jordan (Oncall): this is a latency SLO vs throughput tradeoff gone wrong for short sequences. We need immediate recovery.
Alex (Runtime): propose rollback of the batching policy change (revert config commit `cfg-2028-batcher`) and pin `microbatch_max_size=12` until autotuner refined.
Deploy Bot: scheduled rollback of `deploy/2028` at 23:18 UTC — start in 2m.
Raj (Infra): initiating rollback now. will watch k8s rollout gracefully.
SRE Bot: rollback completed on 6/6 pods, out of 6. no image change, config reverted.
Mira (Perf): preliminary metrics: p99 on affected route dropped from 1.2s -> 430ms within 90s of rollback. tail looks back to baseline. :tada:
Helena (ML): confirming KV cache hitrate unchanged — this wasn't a KV thrash issue, primarily queueing + kernel mispick.
Alex (Runtime): next steps: 1) add canary check for queue_depth and p99 on short-seq traffic 2) tweak autotuner to prefer low-latency kernel for batch sizes >=1 and seq_length < 64 3) add a guard that `microbatch_max_size` cannot exceed 16 for models with median seq < 64.
Jordan (Oncall): filing incident ticket and will schedule postmortem. action: @Alex to own the autotuner patch, @Raj to add rollout check gating on p99 regressions, @Mira to add perf test.
Mira (Perf): quick note — add a synthetic load test that simulates many tiny seqs so our canaries actually catch this class of regressions.
Alex (Runtime): agreed. documenting the debugging steps in the incident ticket. thanks for the quick rollback everyone.
Jordan (Oncall): closing oncall loop, will keep incident open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
